scope: One fresh Kind Kubernetes v1.36.1 cluster runs a read-only Python validator Job over abstract, non-operational incident records and a defensive classification/traceability/ownership worksheet. The Job independently validates a deliberately incomplete/misclassified baseline and a complete candidate worksheet, then checks a permitted synthetic positive record. Raw JSON and stable summary evidence are captured. The nine control.* labels and their group boundaries in the fixture are provisional SAF-K8S examples pending verification against an authorized CTA-2114 normative copy; the test does not validate CTA class membership, definitions, or completeness. NIST AI 100-2e2025 is shown only as a separate comparator. The case verifies local worksheet traceability behavior and does not establish production coverage, incident attribution, or CTA conformance.

checks.claim: The worksheet catches missing links and invalid observations
The worksheet accepts completed links and evidence-backed classifications
An independent observation maps to a known owned class
